automation.yaml:
alias: Turn on the hallway light at sunset
trigger:
  - platform: sun
    event: sunset
action:
  - service: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.example_hallway

functional.human_like: Turn on the hallway light at sunset.
functional.structured_description: A sunset trigger activates one hallway light.

security.description: No security issue identified in this synthetic example.

goal_classes.label: comfort
goal_classes.rationale: The automation provides ambient lighting automatically.

automation.yaml:
alias: Notify when a window opens while away
trigger:
  - platform: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.example_window
    to: 'on'
condition:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: person.example_resident
    state: not_home
action:
  - service: notify.mobile_app_example_phone
    data:
      message: A window was opened while nobody was home.

natural_language.conditions: Only while the resident is away.

functional.human_like: Alert the resident if a window opens while the home is empty.
functional.structured_description: A window state change sends a notification when the resident is away.

security.description: The notification supports awareness of unexpected access.

goal_classes.label: security
goal_classes.rationale: The automation reports an unexpected opening while the home is empty.

action_modalities.label: notification
action_modalities.rationale: The action sends a message to a mobile device.

automation.yaml:
alias: Reduce heating when a bedroom window is open
trigger:
  - platform: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.example_bedroom_window
    to: 'on'
    for: '00:05:00'
action:
  - service: climate.set_temperature
    target:
      entity_id: climate.example_bedroom
    data:
      temperature: 16

natural_language.trigger: When the bedroom window remains open for five minutes.
natural_language.action: Lower the bedroom heating set point.

functional.human_like: Reduce bedroom heating if the window stays open.
functional.structured_description: A prolonged open-window state lowers the thermostat set point.

security.description: No security issue identified in this synthetic example.

goal_classes.label: energy_efficiency
goal_classes.rationale: The automation reduces heating while a window is open.

action_modalities.label: environmental_control
action_modalities.rationale: The action changes a thermostat setting.

automation.yaml:
alias: Turn off the kitchen plug at night
trigger:
  - platform: time
    at: '23:30:00'
action:
  - service: switch.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: switch.example_kitchen_plug

functional.human_like: Turn off the kitchen plug every night.
functional.structured_description: A fixed nightly schedule turns off one smart plug.

security.description: No security issue identified in this synthetic example.

goal_classes.label: energy_efficiency
goal_classes.rationale: The automation avoids unnecessary overnight power use.

action_modalities.label: device_control
action_modalities.rationale: The action turns off a smart plug.
